candidate.name: Ellenberg Frey Q-Curve Descent for Signature (2, 4, p)
candidate.text: Candidate: Ellenberg Frey Q-curve descent for the generalized Fermat equation A^2 + B^4 = C^p. Associated to a primitive solution is a Q-curve E over K = Q(i) whose Galois representation arises from a Hilbert modular newform over Q(i). Elimination of residual representations via Kraus sieve over Q(i) and modular forms over imaginary quadratic fields.

legend.0: level 0: peripheral or unrelated to Beal signatures
legend.1: level 1: general modular method context without resolving any signature
legend.2: level 2: settles a concrete range of exponents or a new specific signature family
legend.3: level 3: settles an entire infinite signature family for all exponents
legend.4: level 4: resolves the complete conjecture outright
